findings.title: Hook that throws causes run to hang instead of failing gracefully
findings.description: When a hook throws an error on task:complete, the run hangs indefinitely (times out after 10s) rather than isolating the hook failure and proceeding with downstream tasks.
findings.test: should handle hooks that throw without blocking downstream
findings.evidence: Test timed out in 10000ms. Expected result.failed > 0 and a.txt to exist, but run never completed.

findings.title: Compile output is non-deterministic due to generated_at timestamp
findings.description: Two sequential compiles of the same playbook produce different manifest.json files because the generated_at field changes each run.
findings.reproduce: cd .converge/playbooks/self-improvement-loop && node ../../../packages/cli/dist/index.js compile && node ../../../packages/cli/dist/index.js compile && diff manifest.json from each run
findings.evidence: Compare-Object shows generated_at differs between run1 and run2 manifests.

findings.title: Select range operator '+' returns no matches for epoch-prefixed task IDs
findings.description: The --select 'epoch-013+' operator returns 'No tasks match selection' despite tasks with epoch-013 and higher prefixes existing in the DAG.
findings.evidence: Output: 'No tasks match selection' when DAG has epoch-013 through epoch-019 tasks.

findings.title: Playbook scripts use process.exit(1) instead of structured error propagation
findings.description: Multiple playbook scripts (check-epoch-complete.mjs, check-clean-start.mjs, check-final-diff.mjs, check-patch-manifest.mjs) call process.exit(1) directly, causing hard crashes rather than structured error surfaces.
